query: aspirin acetylsalicylic acid binding COX-2 cyclooxygenase

results.title: Aspirin (CID 2244)
results.abstract: Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug that irreversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX-1 and COX-2) by acetylating a serine residue near the active site. PubChem documents binding interactions relevant to prostaglandin synthesis inhibition.
